title: SEC1: magic numbers 32/64 in context structs
description:
Crypto2DevAesCtx.key is declared as byte key[32] with a comment explaining the sizes. Crypto2DevHmacCtx.key is declared as byte key[64].

These bare integer literals should be replaced with named wolfSSL constants:
- key[32] -> key[AES_256_KEY_SIZE]         (defined in wolfssl/wolfcrypt/aes.h)
- key[64] -> key[WC_HMAC_BLOCK_SIZE]       (defined in wolfssl/wolfcrypt/hmac.h; note: = 128 after fixing wolfssl-eyl)
- keySz > 32 guard -> keySz > AES_256_KEY_SIZE
- keySz > 64 guard -> keySz > WC_HMAC_BLOCK_SIZE

Using named constants ensures the buffer size and the validation guard stay in sync if the constant ever changes, and makes the code self-documenting.

This issue tracks the naming change only. The correctness fix (key[64] is too small) is tracked separately in wolfssl-eyl.

Affected lines: crypto2dev_port.c:250, 255, 612, 969.
